description: Expected Safe identity and owner/threshold bounds for the Safe configuration gate

safe_address.description: The Safe address this policy is bound to. The address the WASM actually read must match this (case-insensitive), otherwise deny.

min_threshold.description: Minimum signature threshold the Safe must require. Below this, deny.

min_owners.description: Minimum number of owners (signers) the Safe must have. Below this, deny.

max_owners.description: Maximum number of owners (signers) the Safe may have. Above this, deny.
